newsitem.title: FRANCE: Vatry all-cargo airport bid coordinator named.
newsitem.headline: Vatry all-cargo airport bid coordinator named.

text.p: The Conseil General de la Marne, the local authority behind the one billion development of a multi-modal freight transport hub, Europort Vatry, said it had appointed Francois Essig to coordinate procedures with the six candidates invited to submit bids to run the hub.
Essig, 63, is a member of France's Council of State and has held various civil service positions at the Ministry of Transport and the French regional development agency, D.A.T.A.R.
He is also president of the Association Francaise pour le Developpement International des Entreprises.

"His brief is to coordinate each phase of the procedure including replying to questions from the candidates, bid analysis, presenting recommendations and assisting the authority in its choice ," a local authority statement said.
Six candidates, grouped into French, international and Franco-international consortia, are to submit bids by September 1997 to run the site.

The French department of the Marne is aiming for a mid-1998 opening of Vatry as an all-cargo airport as part of the conversion of the ex-NATO airfield into a multi-modal freight platform. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
